2123:
## In short

**Jagannātha**, a man of Orissa, was the son of **Kānāi Khuṇṭiyā** (#663), sevāit of Lord Jagannātha at Purī.

## Sources

The record's text. It was in the record «Jagannātha» #570 until 07-11-2026. His brother Balarāma has his own record (#2142).
1950:
## In short

**Rāmadāsa** was **Kuraṅgākṣī** in Vraja-līlā (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 197, 207).

## Sources

The record's text.
2026:
## In short

**Rāmānanda** is named by Jayānanda in his Caitanya-maṅgala (p. 73) as the maternal uncle of **Gadādhara Paṇḍita**.

## Sources

The record's text (from «Vaiṣṇava Biographies A-Z»).
1998:
## In short

**Padmanābha Miśra** was the third son of **Upendra Miśra** (#1575), and so an uncle of **Lord Caitanya** (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 13.57).

## Sources

The record's text; the record of Upendra Miśra (#1575).
2143:
## In short

**Balarāma** was the younger brother of **Śyāmānanda Prabhu** (Rasikamaṅgala Pūrva 2.36).

## Sources

The record's text. It was in the record «Balarāma Dās» #81 until 07-11-2026.
2124:
## In short

**Jagannātha** was **Tārakā** in his former life (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 158).

## Sources

The record's text. It was in the record «Jagannātha» #570 until 07-11-2026.
2166:
## In short

**Makaradhvaja Sena** was **Mañjumedhā sakhī** in Kṛṣṇa-līlā (Vaiṣṇavācāra-darpaṇa).

## Sources

The record's text (from «Vaiṣṇava Biographies A-Z»). It was in the record of the Mahārāṣṭrian brāhmaṇa (#893) until 11-11-2026.
2172:
